extDescription.message: Download any video from VK and VK Video in original quality, up to 4K, using your own session.

stateNotVkText.message: vkgrab works on vk.com and vkvideo.ru. Open a video page and click the icon again.

stateNoVideoText.message: Open a video or a page with video links, then try again.

errNoPlayer.message: VK did not return a player for this video. It may be private, deleted, or you are not signed in.

errNotJson.message: VK returned an unexpected page — sign in to VK and reload the tab.

errDrm.message: the stream is encrypted (DRM), it cannot be saved

errLive.message: Live streams are not supported yet. Wait for the recording.

errNoFormats.message: VK gave no downloadable formats for this video.

errReload.message: Reload the VK tab and try again.

hlsHint.message: downloads inside the tab, keep it open

hlsStarted.message: Downloading in the VK tab, keep it open

footer.message: Uses your VK session. For personal use only.
